title: A quantitative tree-likeness bound from average hyperbolicity
summary: Chatterjee and Sloman proved that a bounded measurable similarity function with sufficiently small average Gromov hyperbolicity admits a tree representation with small mean approximation error. Their argument uses a weighted version of Szemerédi's regularity lemma and does not yield explicit quantitative bounds. Here, we establish a tighter relation between average hyperbolicity and mean tree approximation error.
